ctaHeading: Caroline Springs' test & tag ready to help
aboutText: Based in Caroline Springs, Test and Tag Melbourne provides comprehensive fire safety services for businesses and homes. Our team specialises in regular fire extinguisher inspections, pressure gauge testing, and full compliance with Australian Standards. We ensure your equipment is always ready for immediate use, offering on-site servicing for offices, warehouses, and commercial sites across Melbourne.
servicesText: We provide a full range of test and tag services tailored to your needs. From routine inspections to emergency refills, our expert team ensures your fire safety equipment is always in top condition and compliant with regulations.

services.title: Fire Extinguisher Inspections
services.desc: Regular testing to identify faults early and ensure compliance with Australian safety standards.

services.title: Pressure Gauge Testing
services.desc: Confirms extinguishers are correctly pressurised for reliable performance during emergencies.

services.title: Condition & Safety Checks
services.desc: We inspect for corrosion, leaks, physical damage, and expiry issues to maintain safety.

services.title: Refilling & Recharging
services.desc: Ensures extinguishers are always ready for immediate use with professional refilling services.

services.title: Tagging & Labelling
services.desc: Clear compliance tags and labels for audit purposes and safety records.

services.title: AS 1851 Compliance
services.desc: Full compliance with Australian fire safety regulations for businesses and properties.
